author: ish1416

entries.text: Implemented complete symbolic formula for `MatrixSlice` supporting negative steps, out-of-bounds clipping, and negative index normalization. However, because symbolic expressions are allowed to handle generic cases, the expression can be complicated for matrix shape for generic matrices without sufficient assumptions. Users are encouraged to use assumptions (such as is_integer, is_positive, is_nonnegative) such that evaluation of shape, or MatrixElement can simplify better.
